'''thehooky alot of CCT decks out there, but this is classic and flips on turn 2!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[thehooky]]
* '''Published:''' 28 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif|label=Carbon Chamber Testing}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Any Methods Necessary|ECC-D-anymethodsnecessary.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5)|VS5O-47-Sudden_Impact.png|label=Sudden Impact (V)}}
* '''Strategy:''' Carbon Chamber Testing
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 CCT thehooky DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Boba Fett (V), Boba Fett's Blaster Rifle (V), Slave I (V), Sudden Impact (V), IG-88 (V), Bossk (V), Kitik Keed'kak (V), Prince Xizor (V), Lando Calrissian (V), IT-O (Eyetee-Oh) (V), Greedo (V), Zuckuss (V), Hound's Tooth (V), Punishing One (V), Mist Hunter (V), Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo? (V), Levitation Attack (V), He's All Yours, Bounty Hunter (V), Jabba's Influence (V), Despair (V), Special Delivery (V), Desilijic Tattoo (V), Ket Maliss (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

alot of people play this deck non-flip stile, but this one flipes so fast and sets up for killer drains! why not a little dark deal too?

'5 devices' posted under Sudden Impact (outside the 60); none named, no shields.

== Notes ==

* Posted 'sudden Impact' (unmarked) with '5 devices' under it dested Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5): only the (V) starting effect holds 5 cards from outside the deck (the printed card is a Dagobah Effect). Judgment call against the unmarked-means-printed rule.
* Posted 'Frozzen Han' dested Jabba's Prize / Jabba's Prize; 'CC:jail' Cloud City: Security Tower; 'JP:jail' Jabba's Palace: Dungeon; 'CC: Docking Bay' Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Tat: Docking Bay' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Jabbas Cruiser' Jabba's Space Cruiser; 'Rachalt' Rachalt Hyst.
* Original-era (V) slips: Boba Fett and his Blaster Rifle (VS6), Slave I/Prince Xizor/Zuckuss/Punishing One (VS7), IG-88/Bossk/Hound's Tooth/Mist Hunter/Desilijic Tattoo (VS5), Kitik Keed'kak (VS2), Lando (VS6), IT-O/Ket Maliss/Oo-ta Goo-ta (VS3), Greedo (VS4), Levitation Attack x2 and the VS6 effects.
* Original-era printing corrected: Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 4) -> Greedo (V) (Virtual Set 3); Punishing One (V) (Virtual Set 7) -> Punishing One (V) (Virtual Set 5) (an earlier dest had linked the modern virtual card of the same name).

== Strategy ==

big fat starting hand!

this is how i work the deck for a super fast flip and majer force drain.

turn 1

pull into hand lando, activate at least 4 force, deploy boba and gun to the CC: jail. deploy JP:jail and use fetts gun to pull Ket maliss V. use ket maliss to pull Greedo V and to deploy CC:Docking bay, use CCT to pull JP:Chambor. end turn.

if you have more then 4 force on your first turn then pull special delivery V, and use it to pull ket maliss V.

turn 2

activate at least 8 force, use fett to pull Hes all YBH, then use Ket Maliss to pull Tat:Docking Bay. (if you had deployd special delivary V turn 1) deploy scum and vilany using special Delivary V for 1 force, deploy Mighty Jabba to JP:Chambor for 2 force, use fets gun to deploy Jabbas Influence V and then deploy Ephant Mon there for 3 force, deploy greedo V to CC: chambor for free, and then deploy Lando there for 1 force, use lando V to pull A Real Hero, use Greedo V to pull Oo-ta Goo-ta, solo? V, move fett to JP:Chamber with Hes all YBH, flip CCT!!!

depinding on your starting had and force activation you can set up faster and better.

then for the rest of the game pull Effects as you need them,up to 2 a turn, force drain for alot with IT-O V and Despair V, and if you can get up Bespin:CC then you will be super powerfull on cloude city and have majer force drains!!! you will win the game at that point, you have pluntie of ships and pilots to take over Bespin:CC or put up a good fite out in space.

one card that i really would like to put in is expand the impier and deploy it on JP:chamber so i can pull up more bounty hunters at the Docking bay and the JP:jail.

this is a classic deck, so please keep that in mind. this deck works really good, i have used it agenst a few non classic and i still won! its fun and pulls up every thing really fast.
